rule: Review-disposition membership alone is never promotion authority. A Research snapshot requires a separate protected authorization binding the exact candidate SHA-256, exact canonical review row, exact review-basis SHA-256, source identity, and disposition. PROJECT_CHANGE_REQUIRED is valid only when governed review also binds an exact nonempty PROMOTION_PROPOSED scientific correction proposal plus the protected snapshot and canonical-promotion authorizations required to open a separate correction PR automatically. Executable and control-plane changes are never materialized by this scientific promoter; when implementation_required is true they use the separately authorized FAR-LIVING-IMPLEMENTATION-001 path. Canonical edits require an exact protected-main authorization binding the accepted PROMOTION_PROPOSED proposal, candidate, operation set, and provenance hashes. Source-branch code is never executed. Exact main preimages, payload hashes, regular-file paths, a sealed final diff, a single-commit promotion branch, and protected merge-authority are mandatory.
